speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe the progression of your jaundice and pruritus? Have you noticed any specific changes in your stool color or urine darkness recently? Additionally, how much weight have you lost over the past few months?

Three years ago, he had an episode of acute upper abdominal pain, which was managed with IV fluids, NSAIDs, and dietary modification.
